title: Cross-team mini: cost & coverage census (May 2029)
summary: Short ad-hoc census to align owners, estimate incremental cost buckets and surface coverage gaps for the upcoming launch week. Lightweight, intended for quick triage and owner handoff.
body:
Purpose:
Collect a minimal cross-team view of who covers critical runtime routes, estimated incremental cost if we route surge traffic, and any known handoff friction for the next release window (May 17-24). Use this to prioritize coverage and identify cheap mitigations (rate limiting, temporary fallback routes, manual on-call).

How to use:
- Fill one row per runtime route / feature toggle.
- Estimate 'cost bucket' as approximate % increase in token spend or $ per hour under a surging load (30-100% above baseline).
- Mark 'coverage' as primary owner and a secondary contact for weekend handoffs.
- Use 'quick mitigations' for things we can toggle without infra code changes.

Notes to self / open questions:
- We don't have solid per-route cost telemetry for private deployments; ask infra for 48h rollup.
- If cost buckets are >20% and owner is infra, escalate to capacity planning by EOD May 10.
- Consider temporary quantization profile for chat-heavy routes; tag routes for applied-ml review.

One-off checklist:
- Ping owners for confirmations (Slack thread: #ops-launch-coverage)
- Tag any route that needs emergency fallback policy
- Add to console runbook if mitigation is >2 steps

Rows (columns: route | primary_owner | secondary | coverage_window | est_cost_delta | priority | quick_mitigation | notes):
rows: chat-streaming: /api/v1/chat/stream | Dana Liu | Priya Shah | May17-24 | 18% (~$120/hr) | P1 | enable-prefix-cache | legacy model fallback available; needs canary
embeddings-batch: /api/v1/embeddings/batch | Marco Alvarez | - | May17-20 | 30% (~$90/hr) | P2 | batch-window=15s | Sees nightly spikes, consider reserve slot
reranker-topk: /api/v1/rerank | Alex Kim | Marco Alvarez | May17-24 | 8% (~$35/hr) | P3 | reduce-topk=5 | low risk, but high latency when overloaded
devtools-qa: /api/v1/devtools/* | Interns Team | Dana Liu | May18-19 | 2% (~$10/hr) | P4 | throttle-on-odd-hours | non-prod traffic, can be paused
reporting-export: /api/v1/export | Analytics | Priya Shah | May17-24 | 12% (~$45/hr) | P2 | move-to-dedicated-queue | exports are synchronous; may queue
autocomplete: /api/v1/autocomplete | UX Platform | Marco Alvarez | May17-24 | 22% (~$70/hr) | P1 | reduce-suggestions | user-facing; quality trade-off discussed
private-vpc-route: /private/* | SecOps | Alex Kim | May17-24 | 40% (~$300/hr) | P0 | pre-warm-pool | regulatory; can't use fallback, needs capacity commit
